name: Click Before Frames
description: iOS input-buffer max-delay control prototype with a separate optional debugger. The max delay uses real tick values from 0 to 64; Wave ticks are derived automatically. Input interception remains disabled.

max-delay-ticks.name: Max input delay (ticks)
max-delay-ticks.description: Maximum delay window for the main input buffer. 0 = OFF/raw input; 1–64 selects the actual tick count. Wave is derived from this value: up to 8 ticks uses the same Wave limit, 9–16 keeps Wave at 8, and above 16 uses half the All limit (minimum 8 when the buffer is enabled). This preserves the original 2/2, 4/4, 8/8, 16/8, 24/12, and 32/16 All/Wave presets. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS. This is not the game's physics tick rate.

debugger-enabled.name: Input buffer debugger
debugger-enabled.description: Separately enable/disable diagnostic log messages for the current max input delay and its automatically derived Wave limit. Does not change the selected delay or gameplay.
